test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of March, 2024, who is the minister of the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__ ***Amit Shah***__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amit Shah** is the current Minister of Cooperation as of March 2024.
 
• He also holds the position of** Union Home Minister**.
 
• The Ministry of Cooperation was established in July 2021 to strengthen the cooperative movement in India2.
 
• The Ministry aims to promote cooperative-based economic development models, including the creation of cooperative societies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Annpurna Devi****: **Currently serves as the** Minister of Women and Child Development**.
 
• **Dharmendra Pradhan: **Holds the portfolio of Minister of **Education and Minister of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship**.
 
• **Nitin Gadkari:** Serves as the **Minister of Road Transport and Highways**.
